name: hua-planrelay
description: Workspace-safe planning and review relay for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Let Luna execute and Sol plan or review with consent.
interface.longDescription: Run a bounded coding loop where Luna and Codex execute locally while ChatGPT Sol plans or reviews through a read-only workspace bridge. Browser assistance requires explicit user consent, and reviews are bound to Git and test evidence.
defaultPrompt: Plan the current Hua PlanRelay coding task.
Review the current Hua PlanRelay changes.
Explain the connected workspace without exposing secrets.
